notes.title: Exhibited at "Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition".
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37496234/fae3e0dd990f33dde8441b552a9295d4aa459e06.png[/img]

The demo version of "Sayonara Electric" will be Exhibited to the "Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition" to be held from October 07th to 13th, 2020.
Only the male protagonist could selected it in the "Summer Edition", but it is possible to selected both genders during the "Autumn Edition" period!
If you have already downloaded it, please update it after 7th.
